hook_text: Four corners, one planet, billions of years. Can you explain them all?
clip_script: Space corner: Earth orbits the Sun, about 365 days, one year. Spins on its axis, about 24 hours, one day and one night. Soil corner: weathering turns rock into soil, very slowly. Sandy, clayey, loamy. Keep it covered! Rock corner: sediment settles in layers, squashed and hardened. Sandstone, shale, limestone. Fossil corner: bones, teeth, footprints. The coelacanth, Massospondylus, Mrs Ples. Term 4, complete!
visual_style: Whiteboard classroom wall with four labelled corners, each with a quick sketch: globe, soil jars, rock layers and a fossil.
mood: Proud and confident, like guides showing off their museum.
pacing: Four corners, one quick idea at each.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and be a guide to your own Earth Story wall.
